title: The Rain, 2025
logline: The twenty-eighth January. The sill, four jars, and a fifth thing: the sand dollar from the Sunday of 2020, moved from the corkboard's pin to the sill. The pup, ten. Snow a week later.

panels.composition: The casement window in January rain from inside: four jars and a small sand dollar on the sill, an old three-legged dog asleep in a bed below, the lamp on.
